name: microservice-test-subjects
description: Two production-grade microservice systems plus failure scenarios with ground truth, built as test subjects for Microservice Mapper and its RCA lab.

scripts.install:all: cd shopflow && npm ci && cd ../ledgerline && npm ci && cd ../lab && npm ci
scripts.check:syntax: for f in shopflow/services/*/index.js ledgerline/services/*/index.js shopflow/lib/*.js ledgerline/lib/*.js; do node --check $f || exit 1; done; echo syntax ok
scripts.test: npm run check:syntax && npm run validate
scripts.test:api: make -C shopflow test && make -C ledgerline test
